name: mantun
description: Job hunt & application tracker for Filipino job seekers: daily remote and Philippine job feed with JobStreet-style filters, a Kanban board for applications, and screenshot proof. Built on free tiers: Next.js, Clerk, Neon Postgres & Storage, Vercel.

paragraphs: Find remote and Philippine jobs, apply on the original site, and track every application on a Kanban board, with screenshots as proof. Runs entirely on free tiers.
Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Actions) · Clerk · Neon Postgres + Drizzle ORM · Neon Object Storage · Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui · dnd-kit · Vercel
features: Public job feed, fetched daily from Remotive, Remote OK and Arbeitnow (remote) plus Jooble and JSearch (Philippines). Each job credits and links back to its source, as their API terms require.

JobStreet-style filters that apply instantly, with live counts: location (in the Philippines / remote and open to PH applicants), work arrangement, classification, job type, level, skills, listing time, pay and source.…
Save / Apply. Apply opens the original posting and moves the job to Applied.
Add jobs from anywhere (LinkedIn, JobStreet, OnlineJobs.ph, Indeed, Kalibrr, referrals). Paste the link: the platform is detected and the title/company are auto-filled when the site allows it.
Kanban board: Saved → Applied → Interviewing → Offer → Rejected, with drag and drop (mouse or keyboard), notes, status history, a platform filter and stats.

whatItDoes.text: Find remote and Philippine jobs, apply on the original site, and track every application on a Kanban board, with screenshots as proof. Runs entirely on free tiers.
